customManagers.description: Bump the phx-adr pins in the adrs CI job and AGENTS.md together (ADR 018 in todofixthis/cookiecutter-py).
Update the bundled Dockerfiles' annotated ARG version pins
Update the Ubuntu tags in the user docs alongside the Dockerfiles' base image (ADR 016)
Update README.rst's CLAUDE_CODE_VERSION default alongside the Dockerfiles'
Update README.rst's NODE_VERSION default alongside the Dockerfiles'
Update README.rst's OPENCODE_VERSION default alongside the Dockerfiles'
Update README.rst's PYTHON_VERSION default alongside the Dockerfiles'

lockFileMaintenance.description: Refresh uv.lock, and infra/github/.terraform.lock.hcl once committed, weekly, merging once CI passes, so transitive dependencies reach the project without a direct pin (ADR 013 in todofixthis/cookiecutter-py); the Terraform lock needs no plan (ADR 025).

packageRules.description: Never bump Python: an agent session rotates it with the rotate-python-versions skill, which also removes compat code (ADR 015 in todofixthis/cookiecutter-py).
Track Claude Code's stable channel rather than latest, which moves almost daily
Let an OpenCode release settle for three days: it has no stable channel and ships several times a week

Keep the bundled Dockerfiles' PYTHON_VERSION, and its README.rst copy, at major.minor, which deadsnakes' package names use, and skip pre-releases. Placed after the rule disabling Python bumps, which targets the project's own Python, so the later rule re-enables these files.

Never bump the GitHub provider's major: the todofixthis Terraform module owns that constraint, so a new major arrives through a module release (ADR 001 in todofixthis/terraform-github-repository; ADR 025 in todofixthis/cookiecutter-py).
